caption: The drawing displays a cylindrical vessel, likely metallic, standing on three small rounded feet. The vessel has a dark, shaded appearance, indicating a monochromatic or grayscale rendering. Around the upper rim, there is an inscription in a cursive script, which appears to be a name and possibly a date: "Lachmand, Roberrand" and "1835." The central part of the vessel is decorated with engraved imagery and patterns. These include two crossed axes, a crown-like symbol, foliage or laurel motifs on each side, and a few other small, detailed objects such as bottles and tools. The vessel has a slightly uneven surface texture, and the perspective is from above, showing some of the vessel’s interior as well. The entire image is surrounded by a simple rectangular border, set against a plain, lightly tinted background.
title: Pewter Beaker
